author: Totally Not Mark
description:
After watching the finale to The Amazing Digital Circus, arguably the most successful show to ever spawn from the internet, I was excited to share my thoughts and critiques of a show I've grown to love as well as examine some of the reactions that confused me online. 

No Ragatha this time sorry! :D

Special thanks to all the cast, crew and Gooseworx herself for sharing such an emotional and personal story. 

MUSIC COVERS USED:

Isn't She Lovely (Colza)
Your New Home Epic Ver. (David Makes Music)
Digital Days (Kodama Kunamaki)
title: The Finale No One Can Agree On
